qs.q: What is the biological outcome when a gene defect causes a deficiency in melanin synthesis, resulting in albinism?
qs.e: Albinism is a decisive effect on human health resulting from a deficiency in melanin synthesis, affecting pigment development. Phenylketonuria involves the breakdown of phenylalanine instead.

qs.q: Pigmentation disorders of the skin have distinct embryological and physiological bases. What is the underlying cause of albinism?
o: Genetic absence of melanin colour pigment
qs.e: Albinism is defined by the genetic absence of the colour pigment melanin. Hyperkeratinization is instead the basis for ichthyosis-type scaling.

qs.q: Albinism is a hereditary disease due to absence of the skin pigment melanin. The allele for albinism is recessive to the allele for normal pigment. One person in 10,000 is albino. What is the frequency of the dominant allele?
qs.e: If 1/10,000 is albino, then q² = 0.0001, so q = 0.01. Therefore, p = 1 - 0.01 = 0.99.
